entities.summary: Jacob Gilyard is an American professional basketball player for BCM Gravelines-Dunkerque in the LNB Élite. He played college basketball for the Richmond Spiders. Gilyard is the all-time NCAA career steals leader, breaking the previous record of 385 on December 5, 2021, and finishing his career with 466 steals.
